actions.action: Finger-test soil moisture 2-3 inches deep before watering
Lift nursery pot out of cachepot and empty standing water
Water thoroughly until it drains, only when top soil is dry
Move plant closer to a bright window out of direct midday sun
Move away from vents, heaters, drafts, and off wall/curtain
Use filtered or rainwater if tap water is hard
Once new growth appears, feed with diluted palm fertilizer in spring/summer
Trim brown tips and remove fully dead fronds with clean scissors
Inspect undersides of leaves for spider mites
Report watering frequency and light conditions for further help

reason: Low light appears only as the third of several possible causes, behind acclimation stress and watering, so the diagnosis is partial; the fix of moving it to a bright window is present but buried among many other steps, and nothing suggested is likely to harm the plant.
